title: International application.
bodyText: A court of the State of Hawaii may treat a foreign country as if it were a state for the purpose of applying this part and parts II, III, and IV.
bodyHtml: [§551G-3]  International application.  A court of the State of Hawaii may treat a foreign country as if it were a state for the purpose of applying this part and parts II, III, and IV. [L 2012, c 236, pt of §1]
